title: LiveIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: live.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Live server/events/search-documents.js; roadmap WS-O task 10). A Search tombstone: Search drops the document at this revision or older. Only sent for a document Search was sent before. Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:live.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
